generationInputs.prompt: A luminous pink donut, almost ethereal in its lightness, sits centrally against a light pink background. The donut has a female leg, clad in a black fishnet stocking and a black high-heeled shoe, emerging from its center. Viscous pink liquid drips from the donut, and a small pinkish-red flower rests upon it. Tiny, brightly colored sprinkles and diamonds are scattered across the icing, adding a delicate sparkle. Multiple female arms emerge from the donut. One hand holds a glass pipe emitting pink smoke. Another hand holds a syringe with bright pink liquid. Another hand holds a piece of cotton candy. The overall impression is one of lightness and airiness, the donut appearing almost weightless, with a dreamlike, slightly otherworldly quality due to the holographic effect of the icing. The light pink background softly complements the donut's color, maintaining a feeling of delicate sweetness and ethereal beauty.
